mapper.select: SELECT ps.id, ps.project_id, COALESCE(ps.stage_type, 'CONSTRUCTION') as stage_type, ps.stage, ps.stage as stage_name, ps.stage_order, ps.plan_start_date, ps.plan_end_date, ps.actual_start_date, ps.actual_end_date, ps.status, ps.completion_rate, ps.description FROM project_schedules ps WHERE ps.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY ps.stage_order ASC

SELECT psr.id, psr.schedule_id, psr.project_id, ps.stage, ps.stage as stage_name, psr.acceptance_title as title, psr.acceptance_content as description, psr.record_type as type, psr.created_at as create_time, psr.created_by as create_by, psr.acceptor as create_by_name, 'staff' as create_by_role, psr.acceptance_result as inspection_status FROM project_schedule_records psr LEFT JOIN project_schedules ps ON psr.schedule_id = ps.id WHERE psr.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} ORDER BY psr.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT psr.id, psr.schedule_id, psr.project_id, ps.stage, ps.stage as stage_name, psr.acceptance_title as title, psr.acceptance_content as description, psr.record_type as type, psr.created_at as create_time, psr.created_by as create_by, psr.acceptor as create_by_name, 'staff' as create_by_role, psr.acceptance_result as inspection_status FROM project_schedule_records psr LEFT JOIN project_schedules ps ON psr.schedule_id = ps.id WHERE psr.id = #{recordId}
SELECT '' as fileName, '' as fileUrl, 0 as fileSize, '' as fileType FROM dual WHERE 1=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_schedule_records ( id, project_id, schedule_id, record_type, images, acceptance_title, acceptance_content, acceptance_result, acceptance_time, acceptor, created_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{projectId}, #{scheduleId}, #{recordType}, #{images}, #{acceptanceTitle}, #{acceptanceContent}, #{acceptanceResult}, #{acceptanceTime}, #{acceptor}, #{createBy}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT created_by FROM project_schedule_records WHERE id = #{recordId}
